Question 3
?

A=[32−3−4] Consider the matrix A above. Which of the following represents the corresponding bilinear form xTAy in terms of the components of x=[x1x2] and y=[y1y2]?

a
2x1y1+3x1y2−3x2y1−4x2y2
b
3x1y1+2x1y2−3x2y1−4x2y2
c
x1y1+2x1y2−4x2y1−3x2y2
d
x1y1−4x1y2−3x2y1−x2y2
e
4x1y1+2x1y2−3x2y1−x2y2
Submit
